transformations: Keep active PPL, PPLA, PPLA2, PPLA3, PPLA4, PPLC, and PPLG records; include every PPLC/PPLA and otherwise require population of at least 100000
Require a non-empty admin1 code and join countries and admin-1 regions by exact source identifiers; exclude records without either exact join
Select current English and zh-CN, zh-Hans, or zh names without machine translation

Convert only existing zh-CN, zh-Hans, and zh source names from OpenCC traditional Chinese to Simplified Chinese with opencc-js 1.4.1 t-to-cn dictionaries; retain each distinct original form as a search alias

Retain every distinct accepted Chinese source form and its distinct Simplified Chinese derivative; retain distinct canonical and ASCII names plus at most two additional non-display English aliases after normalized deduplication
Sort records by GeoNames ID and encode coordinates as signed 1e-5 degree integers in a lexical string table
missingValuePolicy: Records without valid coordinates, a non-empty admin1 code, an exact ISO2 country join, or an exact country.admin1 join are excluded. Missing Chinese labels use and count the canonical source label; non-Chinese values are never translated or imputed.
boundaryPolicy: This is a filtered major-city search index, not a complete gazetteer or territorial authority.
